reason: E1 shows SRO reduces screw double-kink nucleation and enhances edge mobility in MoNbTaW, but this is a different alloy system (BCC refractory HEA) and the hypothesis applies these mechanisms to CoCrFeNiTi without direct evidence. E2 reports mechanical properties of CoCrFeNiTi but does not mention SRO or dislocation mechanisms. The key premise that SRO governs the deformation behavior of CoCrFeNiTi is therefore unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: SRO reduces double-kink nucleation rate in screw dislocations
Limited SRO in equimolar CoCrFeNiTi leads to lower lattice friction
Lower lattice friction results in lower hardness and strength but good ductility
Inducing SRO via annealing will increase strength/hardness and reduce plasticity
